title: ID0444749-DC/Si-D/BR- [MP / R1 170001473] Replace screen
description:
Reported behavior/issue:  The device above has a screen that's off. We've already measured the 24V power supply from the connector and checked the other cables.
Solution: Replace HMI

additional_info.subject: replace screen
additional_info.body:
Hello support team
Sicharge D :
04dD51
The device above has a screen that's off. We've already measured the 24V power supply from the connector and checked the other cables.
We'll replace the screen tomorrow, with the following items, considering the charger has a Gen 1 screen:
8EM59021AA006AA1
8EM59021AA020AA8
8EM59050AA008AA6
The replacement will be performed by a trained professional, and we'd like the user manual for the adaptation kit.
With best regards,
